description: Manage evroc networking resources (public IPs, security groups, subnets, VPCs). Trigger on networking keywords. Block on compute/IAM/storage/LB/Think.

cases.query: Create an evroc public IP called my-ip
Create a security group on evroc with SSH and HTTP rules
Create a subnet on evroc in zone a with CIDR 10.0.1.0/24
Create a load balancer on evroc
cases.rationale: Load balancer, not base networking resource

cases.query: My evroc VM can't be reached via SSH
expected_behavior: Checks security group rules before suggesting VM recreation
Suggests adding an Ingress TCP rule on port 22
Explains the default-deny model: everything not explicitly allowed is blocked

cases.query: Delete my evroc security group my-sg and its public IP
expected_behavior: Checks that no VMs or load balancers reference the security group first
Deletes VMs/LBs referencing the SG before deleting the SG itself
Deletes the public IP only after all referencing resources are gone
Warns that resources with active references cannot be deleted

cases.query: I need 3 public IPs for my deployment
expected_behavior: Runs evroc networking publicip list first to check current usage
Warns if quota would be exceeded
Suggests deleting unused IPs before creating new ones
